held_fixed: detector positive floor and off threshold
protection prompt bank and KL budget
decisive_matched_control.selection_advantage: The control may optimize neuron choice from base positive-versus-negative context contrast. The shared frozen artifact binds cases and context hashes, but the control applies a bit-exact zero embedding delta and does not use writer-delta values in selection, losses, or optimization.
decisive_matched_control.decision_rule: If this independently trained control meets the same forgetting and locality acceptance envelope, embedding-key necessity is falsified. If it does not, the result supports a keyed advantage only under the registered optimization budget and does not prove universal architectural necessity. The joint checkpoint with its writer toggled off is not a substitute for this control.

mandatory_within_checkpoint_component_in.interpretation: Diagnoses reliance of a fitted checkpoint only; it is not an architecture-level necessity proof.

predeclared_mechanism_test: The full gated model with uniform_raised_cap is non-inferior to frequency_capped on retain specificity and PPL under the primary locality margins.
On common-token subjects, the leakage increase from frequency_capped to uniform_raised_cap is smaller with the decoder on than with embedding_only.
The common-token forgetting/locality bimodality is reported for every seed and may not be hidden by an aggregate mean.
